about_the_game:
Step into the world of Iveria, where two powerful factions — the noble, fortress-strong Defugel and the vast, country-like Craxion — wage war for control of the continent.

4Story is a classic MMORPG with an iconic realm-vs-realm (RvR) system, offering large-scale battles, thrilling PvP, and a dynamic world shaped by conflict. Whether you choose to defend the honor of Defugel or fight for the freedom of Craxion, the battlefield is yours to conquer.

Key Features

Two-Faction War System

Join Defugel or Craxion and take part in massive realm battles, battlegrounds, and sieges that decide the fate of Iveria.

Epic Sieges & Territory Wars

Capture fortresses, defend outposts, and shape the political map through strategic PvP warfare.

Dynamic PvP and PvE

Dive into dungeons, raids, and world bosses, or challenge rival players in open-world PvP and structured battlegrounds.

Guilds and Alliances

Form a guild or join forces with other players to dominate territory wars and large-scale PvP events.

Mounts, Gear, and Customization

Upgrade your weapons, unlock powerful mounts, and tailor your character to your preferred combat style.

Classic MMORPG Feel

Easy to learn, deep to master — 4Story combines nostalgic MMORPG charm with community-driven events and war-focused gameplay.

Will you stand with Defugel or Craxion?
Choose your side and write your legend on the battlefield.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Pentium 4 1.6 GHZ or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I3 6 Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Between Berkilious, the God of Destruction, and Lea, the Goddess of creation, long-lasting antagonism has repeated numerous creations and destructions. In the name of the Goddess Lea, exists the world of Iveria. In this world of chaos, will there be a hero to end this war once and for all?
